reviewScope: All 24 revision-048 treatment outputs and all 9 matched revision-029 controls, inspected directly at full 512x512 resolution.
campaignVerdict: Revision 048 materially increases authored structural authority across divergent completion basins. The increase is not free: under neutral maquette completion, the same carrier is more likely than revision 029 to remain visibly close to the low-poly source instead of accepting prior-driven finishing.
changedBeliefs: Feature-led transformation prompts can preserve the revised carrier while adding radically different anatomy, material, and surface semantics.
Carrier convergence changes generator behavior before species naming is required; the source is no longer merely a loose silhouette hint.
More authored structure can inhibit neutral elaboration. Carrier authority and finish pressure are separate controls that now need to be tuned together.
Whole-result noun prompts preserve source identity but systematically under-elaborate relative to transformation verbs plus concrete feature clauses.

matchedControlDisposition.dragon: Local increase in structural authority across all three matched seeds: cleaner neck/shoulder/barrel/hindquarter separation, with seed identity still dominant.
matchedControlDisposition.golem: Strongest matched evidence because rigid plates expose organization. Revision 048 retains the higher neck and separated masses more cleanly.
matchedControlDisposition.maquette: Revision 029 produces a polished flesh creature in all three seeds. Revision 048 ranges from partially finished to near-literal carrier, establishing an authority-versus-elaboration trade.

familyDisposition.skin: admitted-continuous-surface; seed 80413 remains behind an explicit visual reveal because of superficial abrasion marks
familyDisposition.fur: admitted-macrostructure; authored surface detail partially occluded and head prior drifts toward bear/wolf

claimCeiling: Qualitative evidence of prompt-family and carrier-revision effects under one Flux route and three fixed seeds; not a production reliability estimate or universal model claim.
trellisReviewScope: Six authenticated GLBs inspected through six hash-bound orthographic texture views each; one fixed Trellis seed 42 and one effective trellis2mlx_fast route.
trellisCampaignVerdict: Five of six selected Flux completions reconstruct as coherent closed quadrupeds across a full orbit. Dragon and golem are the strongest structural witnesses; phantom, maquette, and skin preserve macrostructure with mechanism-specific smoothing or arbitrary detail. Fur preserves macro-volume but decodes as dense shard geometry and is not admitted as usable hair.
